models.name: Smoke demo net (tiny)
models.description: Demo net from the smoke pipeline: 16 channels, 2 residual blocks, trained on a handful of self-play games. Included so the app's model loading and on-device inference can be tested end to end.
models.notes: DEMO NET — not strong. Trained on only a handful of self-play games with a tiny network; it plays poorly and must not be presented as a strong opponent. Real strength needs AlphaZero-scale training (see ml/README.md).
